changelog: Safety: symlinks and junctions are no longer followed, so the sweep can never leave the transcode directory; a transcode path that is not Jellyfin's default now requires the new "Allow cleaning a custom transcode directory" setting; a filesystem root is refused outright; and an unreadable subfolder no longer aborts the run.
description: Adds a maintenance task that deletes files from the transcode temp directory once they are older than a configurable number of hours, so abandoned transcodes stop filling up the disk.
name: Clear Transcodes
overview: Keeps the transcode temp folder from filling up.
